Sample.evidence_source: The 3 treatment groups were well balanced on demographic and almost all clinical variables (Table 2). Overall, there was a trend for the proportion of subjects that was seriously functionally impaired (CGAS < 60) to differ among the groups (\chi^2 = 5.60; df = 2; P = .06), with a significant difference between CBT and the NST cell (40.5% vs 65.7%; \chi^2 = 4.57; df = 1; P = .03).
Sample.warning: N for the sample is not reported in this section.

IPT.evidence_source: a significant difference between CBT and the NST cell
